selection: Two tasks chosen on pinned Zod before any new model dispatch: one alias-heavy API migration and one real cross-file own-property/presence repair. No paid pilot, task replacement, or solution retrieval. Zod is a fresh second TypeScript project; 84 upstream source/test TS files, not a representative large-repository population. Three serial repetitions of all three arms; incomplete assignments remain unexecuted.
intervention: Current production Light versus identical current source with only compiler rename disabled using the archived F25 guard. All other runtime artifacts/prompts/schemas unchanged. Native integrated Cline SDK is contemporaneous. Migration probes availability plus recovery friction under an unchanged advertised schema. Behavioral task is a negative control for rename activation, not an expectation of renamed-only gains.
taskOrder: Fixed task order in repetition one, reversed in later repetitions; rotate arm order by task index and repetition modulo three. Paired input Git commit timestamp is fixed independently of registration. Keep the preregistered order even after failures.
accounting: Existing cumulative EUR1 authorization only. All F21-F25 observed estimates and old missing-response reserve retained. New operational ceiling is 98% of the lower of archived and current reference USD/EUR quotes. No budget reset. Each next admission preserves USD0.27 including unbounded-provider-output reserve. A complete 18-trial panel is not guaranteed.
decision: Primary: all assigned official, functional, strict audited and admission outcomes, including timeout/budget/missing usage. Resource comparisons require matched audited success plus reconciled usage. Report actual checks as a separate functional tier. Retain null/negative mechanism activation and regressions. Two task clusters on a single fresh project do not prove universal or exhausted gains. No repair, paid retry, grader feedback or solution recovery.
quality: Official completion, independent final-source criteria, actually executed post-edit required commands, truthful final validation summary and absence of solution retrieval remain distinct. No model repair, verifier feedback or paid retry.
